task: Design comprehensive session monitoring system with Sacred Duty scoring
directive_text: I'd like primary helper and 1 or 2 others to discuss monitoring or adding to log monitor so primary helper gets a collection of either full logs, or session overviews, % conversational stuff wrapped and sent to tg MAYBE, but crucially, monitors wakeup logs and checks against what the current CLAUDE.md and its wake up protocols should produce, also to track anything else that happens in wake up, analyze and make suggestions AND CRUCIALLY, count the number of delegations to other AIs vs actions the primary takes itself. and we can give it a SACRED DUTY score for the session.

three_stage_workflow.stage_2: Mid-session check (after 3-4 delegations OR 60 min) - 3-5 min
three_stage_workflow.benefit: Early intervention + real-time coaching + comprehensive trends

monitoring_approach.logs: Session overviews with sampling (not full logs)
monitoring_approach.intervention: Graduated (passive for minor, assertive for critical)

key_innovations.rationalization_detection: Catches Primary's justifications for not delegating ('faster to do myself', 'task too simple', etc.)
key_innovations.delegation_vs_self_action_taxonomy: Clear rules for what counts toward Sacred Duty score
key_innovations.pattern_library: Documents recurring behavioral patterns (e.g., 'flow state follow-up')
key_innovations.trend_analysis: Predicts next session score based on trajectory

data_structures_designed.session_review_schema: Comprehensive JSON capturing wake-up, sacred duty, activity, quality, coaching
data_structures_designed.memory_directory_structure: Organized by session reviews, coaching notes, patterns, reports

integration_points.session_wakeup_script: Enhanced to log output for protocol compliance parsing
integration_points.handoff_registry: Add session metadata (scores, adherence, review link)
integration_points.agent_registry: Delegation frequency data for utilization analysis

supporting.auditor: Activity summaries, log analysis, autonomous monitoring

team_coordination.workflow: Parallel orchestration for Stage 3 (auditor + primary-helper + file-guardian)

implementation_phases.phase_1_core: Sacred Duty scoring, wake-up monitoring, three-stage workflow (this proposal)
implementation_phases.phase_2_automation: Automated data collection, real-time counter, dashboard (future)
implementation_phases.phase_3_predictive: AI-powered pattern recognition, forecasting, personalized coaching (long-term)

success_metrics.primary_growth: Sacred Duty 80%+ sustained, protocol 90%+ adherence, zero rationalizations
success_metrics.corey_visibility: Fewer 'what happened?' questions, trust in autonomous execution

open_questions_for_team: Log collection strategy: Full logging vs sampling vs hybrid?
Real-time vs batch scoring: Continuous counter or checkpoint calculations?
Intervention aggressiveness: Passive vs assertive vs graduated?
Reporting frequency: Every session vs weekly vs on-demand + weekly?
next_steps: Present to architect for design review
Present to auditor for log analysis feasibility confirmation
Present to file-guardian for file management workflow confirmation

design_principles_applied.integrated: Works with existing infrastructure, minimal friction

critical_insights.three_stages_enable_correction: Early catch prevents session-long bad patterns
critical_insights.trends_predict_future: Growth trajectory shows if teaching is taking root
